testcase.name: Scenario: extrusion-12 Distance tolerance dialog can be inspected and cancelled: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/extrusion/extrusion.feature:110:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: extrusion-12 Distance tolerance dialog can be inspected and cancelled ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given a copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is open with Edit Feature active ✔ When Tolerance is opened from its dropdown ✔ Then Model Value is 8.000 mm and Type is Default ✔ And Precision, evaluated-size controls, Upper and Lower fields, Hole and Shaft fields are visible ✔ When the Type list is opened ✔ Then it offers Default, Basic, Symmetric, Deviation, Limits-Stacked, Limits-Linear, MAX, MIN, Limits/Fits-Stacked, Limits/Fits-Linear, Limits/Fits-Show Size Limits and Limits/Fits-Show Tolerance ✔ When the Type list is dismissed and Cancel is clicked ✔ Then the extrusion panel remains at Distance A 8 mm

testcase.name: Scenario: extrusion-12a Inspect the Distance A editor menu: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/extrusion/extrusion.feature:120:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: extrusion-12a Inspect the Distance A editor menu ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given a copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is open with Edit Feature active ✔ When the user opens the Distance A editor menu ✔ Then it offers Measure, Select Feature Dimension, Parameters, Tolerance and List Parameters ✔ When the user chooses List Parameters ✔ Then a list of parameters available in the active part appears ✔ When the user dismisses the list and clicks Cancel ✔ Then the extrusion edit closes without changing the feature

testcase.name: Scenario: extrusion-12b Select Feature Dimension prompts for a feature: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/extrusion/extrusion.feature:129:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: extrusion-12b Select Feature Dimension prompts for a feature ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given a copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is open with Edit Feature active ✔ When the user opens the Distance A editor menu and chooses Select Feature Dimension ✔ Then the status area asks the user to select a feature and then one of its dimensions ✔ When the user cancels the extrusion edit ✔ Then the accepted feature remains unchanged

testcase.name: Scenario: extrusion-12c Parameters opens the part parameter table: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/extrusion/extrusion.feature:136:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: extrusion-12c Parameters opens the part parameter table ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given a copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is open with Edit Feature active ✔ When the user opens the Distance A editor menu and chooses Parameters ✔ Then a Parameters dialog opens for the active part ✔ And the table includes parameter name, consumed-by, unit or type, equation, nominal value, tolerance and model value columns ✔ When the user clicks Done ✔ Then the extrusion panel remains open ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the accepted feature remains unchanged
